subject: Next steps after demo — hosted pilot options & quickstart
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@safeport.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps after demo — hosted pilot options & quickstart

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time on the demo earlier. Quick recap and recommended next steps so your team can decide whether to start on Hosted API or push for Dedicated/Private: 

Recap (2-minute):
- You liked the latency on short-chat flows and the token-cost profile for embedding + reranking.
- Primary requirement: PHI-sensitive notes ingestion and strict audit logging.
- Secondary requirement: throughput for batch scoring (peaks ~150 req/s) and eventual on-prem roadmap.

Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (high-level):
- Hosted API: fastest time-to-value, no infra setup, built-in prefix/KV caching and streaming. Good for pilots and early prod if you can accept our hosted tenancy + BYOK KMS.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pool for predictable throughput and isolation; good if sustained >1000 qps or you need tenant isolation without on-prem.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): required if you need air-gapped deployment or data never leaves customer network. Longer lead time (weeks) and enterprise licensing.

Recommended path for SafePort pilot: start with Hosted API pilot with BYOK and strict retention + audit hooks. If pilot shows sustained high throughput or additional compliance blockers, transition to Dedicated or Private.

Quickstart items I can action this week: 
1) Provision a trial API key scoped to a single project and endpoints (chat + embeddings).
2) Create two staging endpoints: chat-staging and embeddings-staging and set soft rate caps matching your peak profile (~200 rps burst).
3) Share a short runbook for request patterns, recommended batch sizes, and KV-caching best practices.
4) Add SOC-2 artifacts and audit-log sample to a shared folder.

I've attached a short quickstart PDF with step-by-step for Hosted (hosted_quickstart_guide.pdf) and a basic ratecard CSV so you can model costs.

Next actions — can you confirm:
- Which model families you'd like to pilot (we recommended r-instruct-3b / r-chat-7b for cost/latency tradeoffs),
- Whether BYOK Key is required for the pilot (yes/no),
- A target date to start (week of Apr 27? May 4?).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hosted_quickstart_guide.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@safeport.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after demo — hosted pilot options & quickstart

Elena — thanks for the detailed questions. Short answers below and a proposed hosted-pilot configuration.

Rate caps (behavior):
- Per-endpoint soft cap: 250 rps sustained (configurable per customer for the pilot).
- Burst window: additional 2x burst for short periods (seconds) before circuit breaker; sustained above cap will be throttled.
- Tokenization/embedding batch sizes: we recommend batching embeddings up to 32 items / request for cost efficiency; for chat, set max tokens to 256 and stream responses to reduce perceived latency.

Data residency & BYOK:
- Hosted pilot can be pinned to us-east-1 only (we will not replicate outside the region for the pilot).
- We support BYOK via AWS KMS customer-managed keys; you provide the KMS ARN and we configure envelope encryption.
- Transit: TLS 1.3 enforced.

Audit logs & retention: 
- Audit log format: JSON lines with event_type, timestamp, request_id, user_id, endpoint, model, input_hash (SHA256), costs.tokens_in, costs.tokens_out.
- Retention: default 90 days in Hosted; we can include 12-month retention as an add-on (requires datastore opt-in and extra cost).
> Attachment: hosted_ratecard.csv

Pilot configuration we recommend (Hosted):
- Endpoints: chat-staging (r-chat-7b), embeddings-staging (r-embed-1k)
- Soft caps: chat-staging 200 rps, embeddings-staging 120 rps
- BYOK: yes (customer to provide KMS ARN)
- Audit logs: enable extended retention to 12 months (add-on)

If this looks good I can generate a scoped MSA/terms doc and a pilot SOW including the retention add-on. Typical timeline: 1–2 business days to provision keys & endpoints, then 3–5 business days for pilot QA and traffic ramp.

Kimberly Park
Product Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hosted_ratecard.csv (CSV, small)]
